settings.saveFailed: Could not save that setting. Try again.

backup.importHint: Bring your settings over from another computer.
backup.exportFailed: Could not save the settings file. Try again.
backup.notSettings: That file is not a YapYap settings file.
backup.damaged: YapYap could not read that file. It may be damaged.
backup.replaces: Your current settings will be replaced.
backup.invalidValues_one: 1 invalid value in the file will use the default instead.

problems.autostartFailed: Your system did not let YapYap start at login. Check the login or startup items in your system settings.

settings.autostartReason: So YapYap starts when you log in, as you chose in its settings.

enabled.label: Show the AI assistant in chats
enabled.description: Shows Polish in the message box while you type, and reply suggestions right above it.

model.label: Model
model.description: Auto picks the best model the provider lists for writing messages, or the quickest one on a model server, and follows its newer models.

autoSuggest.label: Suggest replies
autoSuggest.description: Each time you open a chat or something new appears in it, the AI assistant reads the chat and suggests what you could send next, right above the message box.

summaries.label: Summarize unread messages
summaries.description: When you open a chat with many unread messages, the AI assistant summarizes them in a box at the top of the chat. Only in chats the AI assistant may read.

summarizeFrom.label: Unread messages that start a summary
summarizeFrom.description: A chat you open with at least this many unread messages is summarized.

chats.label: Where the AI assistant works
chats.description: It suggests replies, summarizes unread messages and rewrites what you type only in these chats.

messages.label: Messages it reads
messages.description: How many of the open chat’s latest messages it reads to suggest replies, summarize unread messages and rewrite your draft. More gives better answers, but each one takes a little longer.

server.label: Model server address
server.description: A server that speaks OpenAI’s API, on this computer, your home network or the internet.

enabled.label: Let AI agents connect
enabled.description: Runs an MCP server on this computer, so AI agents holding a token you create here can read and write in the chats you allow. Nothing on the network can reach it.

startMinimized.label: Start in the background
startMinimized.description: At login, YapYap starts in the tray, without its window. When you open YapYap yourself, the window shows.
startMinimized.descriptionMac: At login, YapYap starts in the menu bar, without its window. When you open YapYap yourself, the window shows.

autostart.label: Start at login
autostart.description: Start YapYap when you log in to this computer.

betaUpdates.label: Get beta updates
betaUpdates.description: Try each version a few days before its release and help find problems. Betas can be less stable; turning this off waits for the next release rather than going back.

doNotDisturb.label: Do not disturb
doNotDisturb.description: Show no notifications at all, and play no sounds from accounts that are not on screen. Unread counts still update.

closeToTray.label: Close to the tray
closeToTray.description: Closing the window keeps YapYap running in the tray, so notifications keep coming. Quit from the tray or the menu.

enabled.label: Check spelling
enabled.description: Underline misspelled words as you type. On Windows and Linux, each language’s dictionary is downloaded from Google the first time it is used.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Applies to YapYap and to WhatsApp, as long as WhatsApp’s own theme is set to System default.

autoHideMenuBar.label: Hide the menu bar
autoHideMenuBar.description: Press Alt to show it when you need it.

trayIcon.label: Tray icon
trayIcon.description: A one-color icon matches the other icons in your panel or menu bar. Automatic picks the shade that stands out against it.

zoom.label: Interface scale
zoom.description: How large WhatsApp appears. View → Zoom In and Zoom Out go in finer steps, up to 300%.

compactSidebar.label: Compact account sidebar
compactSidebar.description: Show only the color and initial of each account in the sidebar, which appears when several accounts run.

hardwareAcceleration.label: Use hardware acceleration
hardwareAcceleration.description: Uses the graphics card to draw YapYap. Turn this off if the window flickers or stays blank.

displayBackend.label: Display backend
displayBackend.description: How YapYap talks to your display server. Try the other one if the window is blank, blurry or misplaced.

diskCacheMb.label: Disk cache size
diskCacheMb.description: How much disk space WhatsApp’s files may take in the cache. Smaller saves space; WhatsApp may load a little slower.

jsHeapMb.label: Memory limit per page
jsHeapMb.description: The most memory WhatsApp’s scripts may use in one account. Raise it if a large account crashes; lower it to save memory.

hardwareVideoDecoding.label: Use hardware video decoding
hardwareVideoDecoding.description: Uses the graphics card to play videos and video calls. Turn this off if video stutters or shows artifacts.

crashReports.label: Crash reports
crashReports.description: After YapYap closes unexpectedly, keep a redacted report on this computer. Nothing is sent unless you choose to report it on GitHub.

options.ask: Keep a report and offer to review it

notificationSender.label: Show who wrote in notifications
notificationSender.description: Turn this off to show “WhatsApp” instead of the contact or group, for example when others can see your screen.

notificationText.label: Show message text in notifications
notificationText.description: Turn this off to show “New message” instead. The text then never reaches your system’s notifications.

blurWhenUnfocused.label: Blur WhatsApp when YapYap is not in front
blurWhenUnfocused.description: Hides your chats whenever another window is in front of YapYap. Click YapYap to see them again.

blurWhenIdle.label: Blur WhatsApp when you are away
blurWhenIdle.description: Hides your chats after five minutes without using your computer, until you are back.

unreadWhileHidden.label: Keep chats unread while YapYap is hidden
unreadWhileHidden.description: When YapYap is hidden or minimized, WhatsApp does not mark new messages in the open chat as read. Turn this off to let the open chat keep reading.

proxyMode.label: Proxy
proxyMode.description: How YapYap connects. If a proxy cannot be used, YapYap stops connecting rather than going around it.

proxyServer.label: Proxy address
proxyServer.description: Use http://, https:// or socks5://, a host and a port. Saved when you leave the field.

askWhere.label: Ask where to save each file
askWhere.description: Off saves files straight to your Downloads folder. On asks each time, starting in the folder you last chose.

folder.label: Save files to
folder.description: Where files go when YapYap does not ask.

openWhenDone.label: Open files when they finish downloading
openWhenDone.description: Opens PDFs, pictures, sound, video and text in their usual app. Anything that could run a program is only saved.

welcome.title: Welcome to YapYap
welcome.intro: A few choices to start with. You can change any of them later in Settings, and skip this with Escape.
welcome.guide: New to YapYap? Read the six-step guide
welcome.languageNote: YapYap is in English for now. More languages are on their way.
welcome.notificationsNote: YapYap shows WhatsApp’s notifications as your system’s own. The first time, your system may ask whether YapYap may show them.

trace.confirmDetail: For 10 seconds, YapYap records where its time goes: pages, scripts, layout and drawing. Do whatever is slow during that time. The trace holds the addresses of the pages and files YapYap loads, and which parts of their code ran, but no messages, memory dumps or screenshots. It is saved where you choose, and nothing is sent.
trace.savedDetail: Attach it to a bug report if you choose to. To see where the time went, open it at ui.perfetto.dev.
trace.failed: The performance trace could not be recorded.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Describe what went wrong. YapYap sends nothing: it copies the report and opens GitHub in your browser, where you can edit it before you submit it.
report.placeholder: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead
report.diagnosticsHint: Versions, your system, graphics and the end of YapYap’s log, with phone numbers and other personal details removed. Never your messages.
report.opened: The report is on your clipboard, and GitHub is open in your browser.
report.failed: Could not open GitHub. Copy the report instead, and share it another way.
report.copied: The report is on your clipboard.
report.copyFailed: Could not copy the report. Try again.
report.slowHint: A performance trace shows where YapYap’s time goes. It records for 10 seconds while you do what is slow, and saves a file where you choose. Attach it to your report if you like.
report.discard: Discard your description of the problem?

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Each account uses one of WhatsApp’s linked-device slots for its number.
accounts.added: Added {{name}}. To link it, open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Linked devices, and scan the code in the YapYap window.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.muteHint: A muted account shows no notifications and plays no sounds while it is not on screen.
accounts.runHint: An account that is off keeps its login and data on this computer, but receives no messages until you turn it on again.
accounts.proxyHint: Empty uses the proxy in Settings → Network. Otherwise http://, https:// or socks5://, a host and a port; calls then go only through it.
accounts.proxyInvalid: Use http://, https:// or socks5://, then a host and a port, such as socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
accounts.refused: At least one account must keep running, so this one cannot be turned off.
accounts.removeRefused: At least one account must keep running, so this one cannot be removed.
accounts.failed: Could not save the account. Try again.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.notificationsState: Allowed; mute the account to silence them
permissions.forget: Ask Again for Camera and Microphone

accounts.discard: Discard your changes to this account?

settings.intro: Suggests what to send next in the open chat and rewrites what you type, in the tone you choose. It never sends a message: it only puts text in the message box, for you to send.
settings.notSetUp: Not set up yet. Choose a provider below.

key.label: API key
key.saved: A key is saved, encrypted by your system.
key.cannotKeep: This system cannot keep the key safely, so it was not saved. Set up your system’s keychain, then try again.

server.title: Model server
server.description: Ollama or LM Studio on this or another computer, or any service that speaks OpenAI’s API.
server.none: No model server answers on this computer. Start one, such as Ollama, then try again.
server.badAddress: Type a server address, such as http://localhost:11434 or https://example.com/v1. Plain http:// works only on this computer and your home network.
server.keyHint: Only if the server asks for one, as cloud services do.

privacy.listed: Chats you add show up here.
privacy.unnamed: A chat allowed before (its name was not kept)
privacy.noOpenChat: Open a chat in WhatsApp first.

sent.none: Nothing is sent anywhere until you set up a provider.
sent.away: Sends the last {{messages}} messages of the open chat, plus its instructions, to {{company}}. When rewriting, it sends only what you typed. YapYap logs none of it.

bar.label: AI Assistant
bar.use: Puts this reply in the message box, for you to edit or send.
bar.summaryReady_one: The summary of {{count}} unread message is ready.
bar.summaryReady_other: The summary of {{count}} unread messages is ready.
bar.summaryCovers_one: Covers the newest {{count}}, as your history limit allows.
bar.summaryCovers_other: Covers the newest {{count}}, as your history limit allows.
bar.summaryDeclined: The model declined to summarize this chat.
bar.nothingToSummarize: Nothing to summarize: these messages have no text.
bar.declined: The model declined to suggest replies in this chat.

styleHints.elaborate: Fuller and clearer, from the chat

done.polish: Polished. Edit it or send as is.
done.shorten: Shortened. Edit it or send as is.
done.elaborate: Elaborated. Edit it or send as is.
done.soften: Softened. Edit it or send as is.
done.formalize: Formalized. Edit it or send as is.

status.setUp: Set up the AI assistant to start: choose a provider.
status.address: Type your model server’s address in Settings to start.
status.key: Paste your API key for {{provider}} to start.
status.noModel: {{provider}} listed no model. Check its key, or that it runs.
status.server: Your model server does not answer. Check its address, and that it runs, then try again.
status.nothing: The AI assistant had nothing to write. Try again.
status.draftChanged: You changed your message while the AI assistant worked, so it was left as it is.
status.notAllowed: The AI assistant is off in this chat. Turn it on in Settings → AI Assistant.

problems.rateLimited: {{provider}} is busy, or your quota is used up. Try again later.
problems.badRequest: {{provider}} did not accept the request. Try another model.

welcome.title: Your AI assistant
welcome.intro: The AI assistant suggests replies and rewrites what you type, in the message box. It never sends anything without your click. Where should it run?
welcome.local: Use the Model Server on This Computer ({{server}})
welcome.localHint: Private and quick: your messages stay on this computer.
welcome.anthropic: Use Claude with My API Key
welcome.openai: Use OpenAI with My API Key
welcome.keyHint: Quick and capable. What you ask about goes to the service.
welcome.laterHint: You can set it up any time in Settings → AI Assistant.
welcome.done: Done. You can change this in Settings → AI Assistant.

agents.intro: AI agents such as Claude Code connect to YapYap over MCP. Each agent needs a token, which says exactly what it may do, in which accounts and chats, and for how long.
agents.addressHint: Agents connect here with a token. Only this computer can reach it.
agents.off: Turn this on to give agents an address.
agents.portTaken: Another program uses port {{port}}, so agents cannot connect. Pick another port.

problems.invalid: Give the token a name, at least one thing it may do, and at least one account.
problems.noChats: Add at least one chat: type its name or number, then click Add.
problems.unknownAccount: One of the accounts no longer exists.
problems.invalidPhone: One of the numbers is not an international number. Start it with + and the country code, such as +44 7700 900123.
problems.chatsNeeded: A token that opens chats or sends messages must list the chats it may reach, by name or by number.
problems.sendingExpiry: A token that sends messages must expire within 30 days.
problems.tooMany: YapYap keeps at most 20 tokens. Revoke one first.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.unnamedChat: A chat whose name YapYap could not keep

form.title: New token
form.name: Name
form.chatName: Chat name, exactly as WhatsApp shows it
form.chatHint: Give a name, a number, or both. With a number, agents open the chat wherever it is; with a name, they can find it when you ask for that person.
form.noOpenChat: No chat is open in that account.
form.unlimitedSending: With no limit, nothing slows down an agent that a message has tricked, except the chats it may reach.
form.notify: Notify me each time it sends
form.sendWarning: An agent that sends can be tricked by a message someone sends you into sending things you did not want, and WhatsApp may ban numbers that send automatically. Only list chats you trust it with.

created.title: Your new token
created.once: Copy it now: YapYap keeps only a fingerprint of it and cannot show it again.
created.claudeCode: Add it to Claude Code with:
created.other: Other MCP clients connect over HTTP with this header:

scopes.chat:read-unread-summary: See unread chats: name, unread count and last message
scopes.chat:read-active: Read the open chat’s latest messages
scopes.chat:open: Open a chat it lists, by name or by number
scopes.composer:read-draft: Read what is typed in the message box
scopes.composer:insert-draft: Write drafts in the message box, without sending

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.none: No agent has connected since YapYap started.
activity.note: Kept only until YapYap quits, and never with what agents read or wrote.

headless.scan: To link the account “{{account}}”, open WhatsApp on your phone, go to Settings › Linked devices › Link a device, and scan this code:
headless.notTerminal: The account “{{account}}” is not linked. To see the code to scan, start YapYap with --headless in a terminal.
headless.needsBackend: YapYap found no display to run on. Without X11 or Wayland, start headless mode with: yapyap --headless --ozone-platform=headless

chatList.label: Chat list width
chatList.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys, to resize the chat list. Double-click or press Enter to go back to WhatsApp’s own width.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.empty: Nothing downloaded yet in this session.
downloads.kept: YapYap keeps this list only while it runs.

customCode.warning: Advanced. This code runs in WhatsApp and can read your chats. Only add code you understand, and never paste code someone sent you.
customCode.enabledHint: For every account. Takes effect when you save.
customCode.shared: Runs after the code for all accounts
customCode.cssHint: WhatsApp shows your CSS as you type. It is kept only when you save.
customCode.jsHint: Runs when WhatsApp loads, after the code for all accounts, apart from WhatsApp’s own scripts. Reload WhatsApp to run a change.
customCode.failed: Could not save the code. Try again.
customCode.discard: Discard your unsaved changes to the code?

shortcuts.globalHint: These work while you use other apps. They have no keys until you give them some.
shortcuts.notRegistered: Another app already uses those keys, or this system does not let apps use keys everywhere.
shortcuts.press: Press the new keys, or Escape to keep these
shortcuts.invalid: Use a key together with a modifier such as Ctrl, Alt, Shift or ⌘, or a function key alone.
shortcuts.switchEndsInOne: Switching accounts needs keys that end in 1, as it takes 1 to 9.
shortcuts.taken: Those keys are already used for “{{action}}”.

actions.switchAccount: Switch to the first account; 2 to 9 switch to the next ones
actions.privacyScreen: Turn the privacy screen on or off
actions.toggleWindow: Show or hide YapYap, from any app

spellingLanguages.systemHint: Or choose up to {{max}} languages below.
spellingLanguages.noSystem: No dictionary for your system’s language
spellingLanguages.limit: You can check up to {{max}} languages at once.
spellingLanguages.limitReached: That is the most you can check at once. Untick one to choose another.
spellingLanguages.macos: macOS checks spelling in the languages chosen in System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input.
spellingLanguages.dictionariesHint: Downloaded dictionaries stay on this computer, in {{folder}}. A language you untick keeps its dictionary, so choosing it again needs no download.
spellingLanguages.unused_one: 1 dictionary is not used by any language you check.
spellingLanguages.unused_other: {{count}} dictionaries are not used by any language you check.

proxyLogin.title: Sign in to the proxy
proxyLogin.asks: The proxy {{host}} asks for a username and password.
proxyLogin.failed: The proxy did not accept that username and password. Try again.
proxyLogin.rememberHint: Kept encrypted by your system’s keychain.
proxyLogin.cannotRemember: This computer has no keychain YapYap can use, so the password is asked for each time.

logOut.message: Log out and delete this account’s data?
logOut.detail: This deletes WhatsApp’s data on this computer, its login included. Your chats stay on your phone. To use WhatsApp here again, link this device again.

removeAccount.detail: This logs the account out and deletes its WhatsApp data on this computer. Its chats stay on your phone.

unsafeStart.message: YapYap cannot start safely on this system
unsafeStart.detail: Its sandbox is turned off. On Ubuntu 24.04 and later this happens with the AppImage, because the system restricts unprivileged user namespaces. Install the .deb, .rpm or Flatpak package instead, or allow the AppImage with an AppArmor profile. YapYap never runs without its sandbox.

This report was saved on this computer and has not been sent anywhere. Report on GitHub opens a prefilled bug report for you to review and submit.

installUpdate.detail: It was downloaded and verified. Restart YapYap to install it now, or keep working and install it later.

media.detail: YapYap remembers your answer until you quit.
media.systemRefused: macOS does not let YapYap use your {{device}}.
media.systemRefusedDetail: Allow YapYap in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then try again.

notices.safeMode: YapYap started in safe mode, without hardware acceleration.
notices.gpuCrashes: Graphics kept crashing, so YapYap started without hardware acceleration this time.
